checks.tolerance: With the Maker customization flag on, edits face slot 20 and body slot 0 on the imported 7-coordinate card, exports the edited card and reimports it: both rates read back within 1e-5. The exported card's fresh thumbnails are written but not pixel-compared, the Maker shape sliders (the UI half of T-T04) are not driven, and opaque plug-in/Extended Save payloads are preserved by the exporter, not asserted here.

Edits the saved shirt color clothes.parts.0.colorInfo.0.baseColor through the appearance draft (setColor + applySourceAppearance), exports the edited card and reimports it: the rgba reads back on every component within 1/255 (the card stores colors as bytes) and the id stays an applied appearance field. Only that one bound color is scripted; the rendered look of the edit (no pixel comparison), the color picker UI and the unbound hair color fields are not covered.

On the 7-coordinate card, edits the per-outfit clothes color clothes.parts.0.colorInfo.0.baseColor in outfit 0, switches to outfit 1 (which must still show its own saved color 0.16/0.36/0.65/1.0, not the outfit-0 edit), edits the same id there, and switches back: outfit 0 must show its own edit again within 1/255. Export writes every saved color edit keyed by record and path; after a reimport outfit 0 and outfit 1 each read back their own edit. The selected outfit is NOT exported (a view choice exportSourceCard does not store), so the reimport's starting outfit is the importer's default, not a round-tripped value. Rendering and UI controls are not covered.

Edits face slot 0 and body slot 0 off their values, presses reset and exports+reimports: both slots must read the recovered shape contract default 0.5 after the reset and after the reimport within 1e-5. Only these two slots of the 52 face / 44 body values are asserted (a female card; the male body slot 0 = 0.6 contract rule is Engine-suite covered), the reset button itself is not clicked, and nothing is pixel-compared.
